none: PAS DOR-3F3E84: Roman coin: Siliqua of Valens
contea di ritrovamento: Dorset (Inghilterra e Galles)

A, probably plated, contemporary copy of a silver siliqua of Valens (AD 364 - 378) dating to c. AD 364-78 (Reece Period 19). VOT X MVLT XX in a wreath on the reverse. Prototype Mint of Trier, -//TR.
